description: Create a new note, optionally in a folder, from a template, with initial content and frontmatter.

dryRun.description: Preview the change without applying it: returns the planned action and the exact CLI command.

folder.description: Destination folder (vault-relative). Defaults to vault root.

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter keys to stamp on the new note.

name.description: Note name (a '.md' extension is added if missing).

overwrite.description: Overwrite if the note already exists.

name: note_create
title: Create note
